ask: Do you want to leave this as it is, or make it easier to see next time?
problem: One person on the web app saw two reference-audio downloads fail with a server error. Their other 14 files came fine.
found: A short fault at the audio host, most likely. It was one time, about 0.3 seconds. In 7 days the web server counted no other server errors on its general routes. The server cannot show audio errors on their own.
why: One brief fault does not show a bug. A retry changes how the app behaves for everyone, so it is your choice. Option B only makes the next one easy to see.
touches: Option B touches only the server's own counts. Option C touches only the web audio path. Phones are not affected.

options.label: Leave it and watch
options.result: Nothing changes. We act if more people hit it.

options.label: Count these errors on their own
options.result: I add a separate count for audio errors, with a test. Next time we see it at once.

options.label: Retry once on the server
options.result: I add one quick retry and a test. Brief host faults then heal themselves.
